senses.gloss: (b. h., v. גיל) to form a circle, to gather; to rejoice.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 5:1:7">Y. Ber. V, 8ᵈ</cite> bot. (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 2:11">Ps. II, 11</cite>) <he>לכשיבוא יום רעדה תָּגִילוּ</he> when the time of trembling comes (in a disposition of reverence) shall ye assemble (for prayer); cmp. <cite ref="C00724"><he>גִּילָה</he></cite>.
